steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Why is she here...?

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: It's T-Texas!

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: We've already lost a lot of our men!

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Tch, we shouldn't have let Lavinia talk to that piece of trash for so long.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Forget it. After seeing her colleague fall to utter depravity, that woman's spirit is done for.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: As long as we can snuff out Leon's childishness, it doesn't matter how we do it.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Call our people back. We're leaving.

steps.name: Court Clerk
steps.text: They... They turned around and left!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: He's already dead. Took an arrow straight through the heart.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Thank you. If not for you all, I'd have been the one to die here.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Close your eyes, murderer.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: What's this...?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: A notebook?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: A Siracusan judge license. He was keeping it in his breast pocket.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Its corner has been clipped, and it's written here that the holder was disbarred three years ago for malfeasance.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Malfeasance, huh. Malfeasance.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Could they really not come up with a better excuse?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I... think I should be asking you how you got out of prison.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Trade secret.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Fair enough. I don't have the energy to pursue that either right now.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You need to rest.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I can't do that just yet.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: This trail has gone cold. I need another lead.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yan has a saying: 'haste makes waste.'

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Of course I know that.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But time is a luxury I can't afford anymore.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Was Carracci important to you?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I only ever met him a few times.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: After all, I am a judge, and our roles could hardly be further apart.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But as any resident of Volsinii can tell you, he was an extremely vigorous man, smoothly navigating his relationships with the famiglie.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: He dedicated all his time and energy to the construction of the new city area, trying everything at his disposal to give the people a safer place to live.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: By investigating his death, I've come to better understand his life.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Carefully, delicately, as if walking on thin ice, he would desperate rack his brain to produce anything of value that could be exchanged for a little more breathing room to carry out his work.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: For example, building more schools and hospitals far away from the turf fought over by the famiglie.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm not sure how I should think of him. Maybe he was just a decent man, with the slightest bit of a conscience.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But the fates of decent people in Siracusa are already sealed.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Just like this man... a hitman carrying a judge license.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Siracusa has proper law schools.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: They use textbooks published in Columbia. After graduating, students aren't restricted to working in local Siracusan law firms and institutions.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: They also gain accreditation in Columbia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Nowadays, our exchanges with Lungmen are becoming more and more frequent. Maybe with enough time, even Great Yan will come to recognize our certifications.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sounds good.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: It is. Of course it's good.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But none of that makes any difference.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: My alma mater once invited me back to deliver a speech to my juniors, to give them some confidence.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: So I went.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: When I got up on that stage, I wanted to tell them to believe in what they had learned. But I just couldn't do it.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: In Siracusa, the law works because of the existence of a single person, not because it's based on any sort of universally-recognized fairness.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: In a sense, it's even more absurd than complete lawlessness.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: More incredibly, after almost sixty years, the Siracusans have gotten so used to living in this environment that nobody dares to question it now.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Am I justice personified? No. I might be a symbol, but even I do not know what stands behind my back.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...Want to grab a bite?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: ...That'd be nice.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Grazie.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I didn't expect you to be here, Leon.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I heard someone attacked you, so I rushed over.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Nothing major happened, thanks to Texas's help.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But we're at another dead end.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Just drop it already, Lavinia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Leon... I believe we had an agreement not to bring up things that might spark an argument at the table.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Now's not the time for that.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: No, it's the only thing that lets us sit together and share a meal regardless of our positions.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: If you insist on breaking it, then I'm afraid I must take my leave, 'Padrone' Leontuzzo.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You're messing around with your life on the line here!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I've been 'messing around with my life on the line' since the moment I became a judge in this city, Padrone.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'm planning to talk to the Rossatis.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I don't care what they think about Cellinia's presence. This is a discussion they can't avoid.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: We have the initiative. As long as we can keep them down, it doesn't matter if we have a double-agent in our midst, or other famiglie at our throats. We'll suppress them all.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: That's not where the problem lies.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Things are incredibly tense throughout the city right now, and everyone's speculating about who did it. The situation will only spiral out of control unless we stabilize it.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'll be frank. If you can really find the murderer, I'll spare no expense to help you push the case forward.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But right now, the other side has already come prepared. What you encountered today was, without a doubt, a warning shot.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Your investigation won't go anywhere, even if you try to press the issue. You're only going to land yourself in more trouble.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: So I should just go along with your plans, drop the investigation, and let this case fizzle out?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Lavinia, you're not the kind of person to get carried away by her emotions.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Leon, you've worked with Ministro Carracci before. You probably knew him better than I do.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Regardless of how he ended up in that position to begin with, he still was a person who could make the city a better place.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: These things happen every single day.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: So are those in Siracusa who want to be good people doomed to die?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You're more important to me than he was.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: To you, Ministro Carracci's death might be nothing more than a spell of heavy rain.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The rain won't fall on anyone who's standing inside, so you just wonder why it's lasting for so long.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: If you're feeling particularly generous, you might even hand out some umbrellas to the people on the streets.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But for me... I'm sick and tired of asking myself how long I plan to stand there under the roof.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But how are you going to stop the rain all by yourself?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: At least this time, I don't want to feel like a helpless bystander watching someone like Carracci die for nothing.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I've already done too much against my will.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Leon, if - and I mean if - my life could be exchanged for something...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: That might make things a bit more bearable for me.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: One thing I learned from the Columbians is—

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: If you want someone to listen to you, incentives can be more useful than violence.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But that doesn't mean I won't ever choose violence, Lavinia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: And this is exactly what I was talking about: the biggest difference between you and me.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You've always got the option of violence, but you refrain from using it because of your upbringing and self-control. I'd even like to thank you for your kindness.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: That's not what I meant.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: And I'm not blaming you either, Leon.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: For you to even consider why the rain hasn't stopped yet is already exceptionally rare to see.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But you are the next head of Famiglia Bellone.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: And I'm just a judge who can't help herself.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Our world views have always been fundamentally different.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Let's leave things here, Leon.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: If you really want to help me, then keep doing what you need to do.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: If you're able to negotiate with the Rossatis, that would already help ease up the situation.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: However, unless you lock me up right now, nobody will stop me from finding the murderer.
Silence falls across the restaurant.
Leontuzzo wants to think of something else to say, but all the words he can muster in his mind come up blank.
His throat twitches twice, but no words come out.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hold on.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Texas?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Oh right, you should head back with Leon. He'll need you in his negotiations with the Rossatis.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No, I have a better idea.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You needed a culprit, right? Then I'll be the culprit.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Do you even know what you're saying...?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's the quickest way to get the situation under control.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I... don't need others to take pity on me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Don't get the wrong idea.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm doing this for myself.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You're both right. If things continue like this, the situation will only get more and more chaotic, making it harder to find who's actually pulling the strings.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The best method we have is to find the killer before everything spirals out of control.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And of course, the other side will do everything in their power to prevent that.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: So you're going to offer yourself up as bait?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Nobody else is a juicy enough target. I might just fit the bill.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You'd make Texas into the real criminals, and sacrifice some renown to take on all the blame, using peoples' ignorance of your famiglia.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And after that, you can release me.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: That would be the fastest way to stabilize the situation, while also potentially drawing the true mastermind out of hiding.

spans.text: be the fastest way to stabilize the situation, while also potentially drawing the true mastermind out of hiding.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: An ambitious plan... but it might be worth a shot.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: However, you're the last of the Texas bloodline, and this is Siracusa.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Personally, the most important thing about the Texas name is the reputation it brings me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: As I said before, I only have one goal: to see through my agreement with Bellone, and then leave Siracusa.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Then why... Why would you go out of your way to do this?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I also have a number of friends who are trying to change things for the better, in a place called Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'd never accept them dying in vain either.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: If this plan goes well...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: It might even put the other forces behind the scenes in counter-check.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'm really starting to count my lucky stars that you're on our side.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Spare me.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: If this is what we're going with, we'll need this trial to be a barn-burner. Ultimately, that's the only way we're going to keep the other famiglie down.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'll handle all the other arrangements.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Now's our chance to hit back.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Then can you give me your assurance that you'll let me leave Siracusa?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I swear this to you: once we successfully execute this plan, nobody will pursue you ever again.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Those who've kept an eye on you, be it the Rossatis or any other famiglia, will only know that...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: 'Cellinia Texas broke out of prison and fled Siracusa.'

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Sorry, Lavinia. This might fly in the face of the dignity of the law.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: No... I don't think so.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: All that remains... is to see things through.
